core_meaning.short_meaning: One who has performed the Hajj
core_meaning.primary_meaning: Haji is an Arabic-origin name meaning “One who has performed the Hajj”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Haji corresponds to the Arabic form حاجي (Arabic root ح ج ج (ḥ-j-j); حاجّ (ḥājj)). Its core sense is pilgrim (one who performs the hajj). Haji is Arabic حاجّ / حاجي (Ḥājj) 'one who has performed the Hajj' — a title of respect that has become a given name. The source gloss 'traveller' is a loose rendering; the pilgrimage sense is the specific one.
